patthana21.11:1.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ na anāsavaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā āsavavippayutto anāsavo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, āsavavippayuttaṃ na anāsavaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto sāsavo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā dve.
patthana21.11:2.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ na anāvasaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto sāsavo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.11:3.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ na sāsavaṃ na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto sāsavo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, āsavavippayuttaṃ na anāsavaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto sāsavo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā dve. na saññojanaṃ akusalaṃ
